LanguageData.Mugirl_Blindfold.description: A restraint designed to obstruct a Mugirl's vision; sensory deprivation is said to heighten the victim's sensitivity (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧. The blindfold features a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].
LanguageData.Mugirl_Blindfold.label: Mugirl Slave Blindfold
LanguageData.Mugirl_Earplugs.description: A fully enclosed restraint device designed to block a Mugirl's hearing entirely. Once fitted, external sounds become almost inaudible, leaving the victim in a silent and isolated environment. The earplugs feature a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].
LanguageData.Mugirl_Earplugs.label: Mugirl Slave Earplugs
LanguageData.Mugirl_Gagstick.description: A restraint designed to restrict a Mugirl's voice, effectively preventing clear speech and allowing only muffled whimpers. The gagstick features a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be opened with a [Rough Restraint Key].
LanguageData.Mugirl_Gagstick.label: Mugirl Slave Gagstick
